rows.office_of_the_principal_district_judge_k: Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class
Honorarium Rs.45,000 per month plus Rs.5,000 per month conveyance

Any one of the following: retired or resigned AP State Judicial Service officer; AP Judicial Ministerial Subordinate Service post not below Superintendent with a Law Degree; Section Officer or above in AP High Court Service with a Law Degree; Advocate with at least 5 years' practice and not on the rolls of the Bar Council at present; retired Gazetted Officer with a Law Degree or who passed the Criminal Judicial Test in full and exercised Magisterial Powers for not less than three years.
Non-practicing Advocate: above 45 years and below 65 years; retired persons: at least one and half years to complete 65 years of age (on the date of notification)
Office of the Principal District Judge, Kurnool

content_sections.heading: District Court Kurnool Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 09/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download District Court Kurnool notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Held any post in Andhra Pradesh State Judicial Service and retired or resigned; Held a post in the Andhra Pradesh Judicial Ministerial Subordinate Service not below the rank of Superintendent (Category-III of Andhra Pradesh Judicial Ministerial Subordinate Service Rules, 2019) and has a Law Degree; Held a post of Section Officer and above in the Andhra Pradesh High Court Service and has a Law Degree; Practiced as an Advocate at least for five years and at present not on the rolls of the Bar Council; Retired Gazetted Officer possessing Law Degree or who has passed the Criminal Judicial Test in full (IPC and CrPC, or BNS 2023 and BNSS 2023) conducted by APPSC, and has exercised Magisterial Powers for not less than three years Experience: A suitable retired Judicial Officer shall be given preference. Age limit: Non-practicing Advocate: above 45 years and below 65 years; retired persons: at least one and half years to complete 65 years of age (on the date of notification) Other conditions: Non-practicing Advocate must have practice at the Bar of not less than five years Court work 5 days a week, Monday to Friday, between 7.30 a.m. and 10.30 a.m. Under administrative control of the Chief Judicial Magistrate for leave, honorarium, inspection and assuming charge Casual leave not exceeding 15 days in a calendar year; no other kind of leave Unit of appointment is the candidate's respective Judicial District Fitness certificate on state of health to be enclosed with the form Desirable: A suitable retired Judicial Officer shall be given preference

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for District Court Kurnool Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: A practicing advocate A member of any State or Local Authority, or of the State Legislature or Parliament One dismissed, removed or compulsorily retired from State/Union/local authority service, or subjected to a major penalty for misconduct One convicted for an offence involving moral delinquency, or charged of an offence of moral turpitude with proceedings pending One of unsound mind, deaf, mute, blind or suffering from leprosy or any other contagious disease; in a bigamous marriage; an insolvent A contractor or businessman interested in a contract or work for Government or local authority within the magistrate's limits

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment is for a tenure; in-charge arrangements are made when the tenure expires or the magistrate attains 65 years

rows.event: Last date for receiving application (below 5 P.M.)

content_sections.heading: How Will District Court Kurnool Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications by the Principal District Judge Written test or interview or both by the Committee of Judges Principal District Judge scrutinises applications and sends only those in order to the High Court Committee of Judges will conduct either written test or interview or both and select the candidates

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Educational qualification certificates B.L. certificate (retired Judicial employees) Certificates evidencing date of birth Certificate of suspension of practice from the concerned Bar Association (Advocates) Self addressed postal cover with stamps of Rs.30/- with acknowledgment One recent colour passport size photograph attested by a Govt. Gazetted Officer, affixed on the application

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District Court Kurnool Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill in the Bio-Data application form printed with the notification (page 5). Give a single application indicating the order of preference for the place of posting. Affix a recent colour passport size photograph attested by a Govt. Gazetted Officer in the space given. Enclose attested copies of the six documents listed in the notification. Send the application so that it is received by 21-12-2026 below 5 P.M.; postal or courier delays are not considered.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications without the six listed documents will be rejected Applications with insufficient information or not in the prescribed form will be summarily rejected Applications received after 5.00 p.m. on the last date will be summarily rejected; postal/courier delays not considered Single application with order of preference for place of posting, per High Court of A.P. ROC.No.515/SO/2021 dt. 11.12.2025

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District Court Kurnool Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 21 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for District Court Kurnool Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Bio-Data application form on page 5 of the notification) and send it to Office of the Principal District Judge, Kurnool, by post or courier, to reach by 21 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for District Court Kurnool Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is non-practicing Advocate: above 45 years and below 65 years; retired persons: at least one and half years to complete 65 years of age (on the date of notification).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Honorarium Rs.45,000 per month plus Rs.5,000 per month conveyance.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Any one of the following: retired or resigned AP State Judicial Service officer; AP Judicial Ministerial Subordinate Service post not below Superintendent with a Law Degree; Section Officer or above in AP High Court Service with a Law Degree; Advocate with at least 5 years' practice and not on the rolls of the Bar Council at present; retired Gazetted Officer with a Law Degree or who passed the Criminal Judicial Test in full and exercised Magisterial Powers for not less than three years.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Non-practicing Advocate must have practice at the Bar of not less than five years. Court work 5 days a week, Monday to Friday, between 7.30 a.m. and 10.30 a.m. Under administrative control of the Chief Judicial Magistrate for leave, honorarium, inspection and assuming charge. Casual leave not exceeding 15 days in a calendar year; no other kind of leave.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: A practicing advocate. A member of any State or Local Authority, or of the State Legislature or Parliament. One dismissed, removed or compulsorily retired from State/Union/local authority service, or subjected to a major penalty for misconduct. One convicted for an offence involving moral delinquency, or charged of an offence of moral turpitude with proceedings pending.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications by the Principal District Judge. Written test or interview or both by the Committee of Judges. Principal District Judge scrutinises applications and sends only those in order to the High Court. Committee of Judges will conduct either written test or interview or both and select the candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment is for a tenure; in-charge arrangements are made when the tenure expires or the magistrate attains 65 years.

faq.question: Q10. Which places are covered by District Court Kurnool Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Pattikonda, Kurnool Unit.
